marker_QC: >=3 reference CpGs; all included profiles finite; GRCh38 CpG-anchored endpoints; standard SniffCell mean difference >=0.4; every constituent profile stays on the assigned side of the comparison midpoint. HBA ODC must also agree with the legacy oligodendrocyte side.
projection: CpG-count-weighted overlap of original reference blocks with author HBA DMRs. Partial blocks use the source block mean. No raw counts are reconstructed.
projection_QC: Project using genomic positions on the actual GRCh38 FASTA CpG axis, not a chromosome-wide offset from original CpG IDs. Exclude source blocks with a CpG-count or endpoint mismatch. Each of the three legacy profiles needs finite block means covering >=80% of reference CpGs in each DMR.
neuronal_merge: Equal 50:50 average of the legacy cortical profile and the equal-major-type hippocampal mean. This is a declared reference weighting, not a count-based pool.

sources.interpretation: Single sample; do not assume a purified neuronal reference from the title alone.

validation.source_copy: Compressed bytes match the candidate checksum exactly.
validation.catalog_structure: Row count, unique evidence IDs and intervals, common cell-type schema, complete complementary groups, finite methylation means, effect and CpG thresholds checked.
validation.existing_pilot_scope: 901 molecule-by-locus observations, five frontal-cortex donors, 24 sample/locus combinations; cell-of-origin truth unavailable.
validation.accuracy: Improved assignment accuracy and regional generalization have not been established.

limitations: Restricted to published HBA DMR intervals; does not preserve all original atlas markers.
Combined modifiedC reference; no separate 5mC or 5hmC profiles for the added cell types.
Cortical/hippocampal grouping and partial-block projection are explicit approximations.
Use the original atlas for read splitting; annotation with this catalog does not automatically retain or combine original labels.
Unexpected cerebellar-reference-like assignments in the frontal-cortex pilot require regional validation.
